fact: Car 23 left the track at turn 1 and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, team radio and in-car video evidence and determined that the driver of Car 30 (Lawson) was on the inside of Turn 1, clearly ahead of Car 23 (Albon) at the apex of Turn 1 when Car 23 went off the track, into the side road. By going off the track, Car 23 was able to get ahead of Car 30 and gain a position. Car 30 did not give the position back and therefore gained a lasting advantage. We imposed a 10 second time penalty on Car 23.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams Racing
